label: rem:ccg-cosimplicial-identities-remark
title: Why the cosimplicial identities hold
html: Each case of the cosimplicial identities, including the mixed identities, reduces either to disjoint-support commutation or to the left-inverse identity \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} \circ \ell_n = \mathrm{id}.
